events.title: EU pulls sponsorship from Disinfo2026 event in Lithuania
events.description: The EU's diplomatic service, Canada and host nation Lithuania all pulled support from a disinformation event in Vilnius. Amid reports of US pressure, the EU said it was "uncomfortable with the framing" of some panels.
